item.title: Rubic Weekly Report 01/29/2026
item.content:encoded:
**Summary:**
1. 🔷 Sui Is Live on Rubic 2. 🚀 MegaETH Integration From Day One 3. ✨ Stellar Expanded Integration 4. 🔊 Relay Support Expanded 5. 🤝 Rubic × Stellar Campaign
**Development**
1. **Sui Is Live on Rubic**
Sui has surpassed 13.3 billion transactions, with over 238 million active wallets on-chain, and now Sui is available on Rubic.
Explore Sui on Rubic Best Rate Finder and swap to and from it via Exolix, Near Intents, Quickex with the best rates & zero Rubic fees for swaps under $100! To make it more convenient, we added support for Suiet and Slush Wallet.
![Sui on Rubic](https://rubic.exchange/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/telegram-cloud-document-2-5463126004543296156-1024x583.png)
2. **MegaETH Integration On Day 1**
As MegaETH's public mainnet launch approaches, we're preparing to go live with full Day 1 integration. Rubic will support both cross-chain and on-chain swaps via Warp Exchange and Relay Protocol, with more integrations to follow.
Just as with the testnet, Rubic will serve as a gateway for early users of the MegaETH mainnet.
Besides, Rubic's API will give dApps Day 1 access to MegaETH as well.
3. **Stellar Expanded Integration **
We've received the Stellar Community Fund grant to implement the integration.
With our tech partner Rock'N'Block, we'll bring Stellar to Rubic's Best Rate Finder, with SimpleSwap, Changelly, ChangeNow and Exolix for cross-chain swaps. Plus, Rubic's Stellar API provider for both on-chain and cross-chain transactions.
Powered by Rubic's Stellar API, we enable cross-chain swaps for a broader range of tokens, with exclusive routes on Rubic, including multihop transactions between Tron and BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche, and Ethereum.
Besides, we've integrated two Stellar wallets: LOBSTR and Freighter.
4. **Relay Support Expanded**
We're enhancing our Relay integration, adding it as a cross-chain provider for Bitcoin, HyperEVM, Scroll, Tron, and zkSync Era. This gives you more options for swaps across chains and adds an additional decentralized route for non-EVM networks like Tron and Bitcoin.
**Marketing**
1. **Rubic × Stellar Campaign**
Following the successful Stellar re-integration on Rubic, we'll be joining a Galxe campaign on Stellar hosted by Allbridge.
Stay tuned for more details!
